parent_objective: design expanded boundary bracketing over underrepresented pair-delta source/fault families
blocked_by: M850 pair-delta-first mining improves raw yield but remains source-limited

public_gates: M853 must target underrepresented pair-delta source seed and fault families
M853 must define boundary expansion gates before pair-delta replay
M853 must keep direct sequence evidence separate from learned self-ID proof
M853 must keep PPO and promotion blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run replay in M853
do not train actor or residual parameters
do not treat M850 pair-delta rows as learned self-ID proof
do not tune boundary thresholds around current positives

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_data: expanded boundary bracketing for pair-delta source coverage
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: starts a new branch after M852 synthesis to expand low-margin boundary sources before pair-delta mining
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no replay, PPO, learned policy claim, or driver promotion
stop_condition: stop if the design cannot target sources absent from M850 balanced pair-delta rows
stop if it would train parameters
stop if it treats direct pair-delta overrides as learned self-ID proof
stop if it only replays the same M850 active set
fallback_plan: if expanded boundary bracketing is feasible, implement it
if source rows are insufficient, return to scenario source generation
if expansion still concentrates positives, synthesize before objective design
if a broad boundary surface emerges, run pair-delta-focused mining as the next branch step
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M852 promotes to pair-delta boundary expansion after source-limited pair-delta mining

hypothesis: Expanded boundary bracketing over underrepresented source/fault/seed families can expose broader pair-delta-positive low-margin states than M850.
success_criteria: M853 writes a design document for pair-delta boundary expansion
M853 defines boundary expansion artifacts and gates
M853 keeps direct pair-delta evidence separate from learned self-ID proof
M853 keeps PPO and promotion blocked
failure_criteria: M853 trains actor or residual parameters
M853 designs another replay of the same source-concentrated active set
decision_rule: M853 may only design no-training expanded boundary bracketing. It must not run replay, train, run PPO, or promote.
next_blocker: pair-delta positives are real but current boundary sources are too concentrated
